model.content: # GitHub Issue #55 ## Title Images ## Description @pi can you see what's in this image? ## Task can you see what's in this image? ## Your Reply pi-action posts your final response as a comment on this issue or pull request. **Do not post your reply yourself**, for example with `gh issue comment`, `gh pr comment`, `gh pr review`, or `gh api`. That would post the same answer twice. Use `gh` to comment only where the task asks for it, such as on another issue. ## Important: Artifact and Script Requirements **CRITICAL:** After the GitHub Action finishes running, all files modified or created are lost, and the GitHub Action runner is destroyed. Therefore: 1. **All generated code and artifacts MUST be committed** - Any files you create, modify, or generate must be committed and pushed to the repository before the action completes. Nothing will persist otherwise. 2. **Any throw-away scripts generated MUST be run immediately** - If you create temporary scripts (like `/tmp/create-issues.sh` or similar), you must execute them during the same session. They will be lost when the runner terminates. 3. **Commit and push all work** - Always end your work by committing and pushing changes to ensure they persist beyond the GitHub Action execution.
